# GitHub Copilot repository instructions

Before doing any work in this repository, read the root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and follow it in full. Read and obey [the shared Ralph-style operating protocol](../docs/operations/RALPH_SHARED_HOURLY_SCHEDULER_PROTOCOL.md). If either is unavailable or contradictory, stop and report the blocker rather than guessing. These instructions apply to chat, coding agent, review, and automated contributions.
